# Code of Conduct

Orion contributors are expected to create a respectful, inclusive, and
constructive environment.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, precise, and open to evidence.
- Critique ideas and implementations rather than people.
- Welcome questions and differing levels of experience.
- Disclose conflicts of interest that affect project decisions.
- Respect privacy and avoid sharing confidential information.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, threats, sexualized conduct,
doxxing, and sustained disruption are not acceptable in project spaces.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove content, restrict participation, or take other
proportionate action. Reporting contacts will be added when repository
ownership is established. Until then, no unverified personal contact is listed.

This policy may be replaced with a formally adopted community code before the
first public release.
